metadata.article_title: Application of order to execution proceedings.

article.title: Application of order to execution proceedings.
article.content: The provisions of this Order shall apply, so far as may be, to proceedings in execution of a decree or order.
article.html:
18AApplication of order to execution proceedings.

Order 26, Rule 18A

The provisions of this Order shall apply, so far as may be, to proceedings in execution of a decree or order.

1 Ins. by Act 104 of 1976, s. 75 (w.e.f. 1-2-1977).
